page.overview:
Who is Velma Udec?

Velma Udec was a banker employed by the Spacing Guild.

Erhi Gan was approached by the Prisoner at her desk in the CHOAM Exchange in Harko Village. She aided them in depositting and withdrawing Solaris to their account.
